tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das ngan song yongs su sbyong ba gtsug tor dgu'i cho ga'i lhan thabs dpag bsam snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bcom ldan 'das ngan song yongs su sbyong ba gtsug tor dgu'i cho ga'i lhan thabs dpag bsam snye ma zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// bde stong dbyer med srid dang zhi ba'i chos// dngos kun gnyis med nam mkha'i rang bzhin du// chos kyi snang bas 'gro rnams srung mdzad pa// yongs kyi bshes gnyen tshogs kyis 'gro 'di skyongs// 'jigs med lnga rigs drang nges dam chos kyi// 'byung gnas gcig pu gsang chen rdo rje'i lam// sbas pa'i don kun 'doms mdzad rdo rje 'dzin// rgyal kun yab gyur khyod la mgos phyag 'tshal// nyi mar 'gong nus mkhyen pa'i snang ba shes bya kun gyi de nyid ston// zla ba'i mdzes 'phrog zhal 'dzum gsar pas skal bzang blo yi ku mud srung*// thugs rje'i myur mgyogs glog gi zhags pas 'gro 'di ngan song gnas nas 'dren// dbyangs can rgyal kun yum gyur khyod kyis rtag par dge ba'i bshes mdzod cig /de'ang 'dir ngan song sbyong ba gtsug tor dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba rdul tshon dang 'brel bar bgyi ba'i lag len lhan thabs su bya ba la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la gsum/ bsnyen pa/ sa chog /sta gon no// dang po la gnyis te/ bsnyen pa dngos dang*/ slob ma rjes su bzung ba'o// dang po ni/ skyabs sems bton nas/ bdag nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge rnam par snang mdzad chen po shin tu gser gyi mdog can 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha lugs dang ldan pa chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang*/ snyan rgyan dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ do shal dang*/ se mo do dang*/ ska rags dang*/ phyag gdub la sogs pas brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs can zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/

zhes gtso rkyang du bskyed la/ stegs bu dpangs su khru phyed pa la rgyar dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur can ngos mnyam zhing dbus cung zad mtho la byang shar yid tsam gzhol ba'i stegs bu me long gi ngos ltar bya ba ni bya bas sbyang ba'o// de nas las sngags bzlas pa'i yungs dkar gyi chu dang sbyin sreg gi thal ba gtor bas sa gzhi bsang ba'i rnam lnga las/ las sngags bzlas pa dri bzang dang sbyar ba dbang ldan nas g.yas skor du byug /lag g.yas rdo rje bzung ba'i sa gnon gyis gzhi der reg la/ oṃ bh+rū khaṃ/ zhes pas sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur par mos la/ hūm̐ laṃ hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ me dī ni badz+rī bha wa badz+ra bhan+dha hūm̐/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du rdo rjes chings shig /ces dang*/ oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ chom zhig chom zhig rdo rje khro bo/ zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sho dha ya sho dha ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sbyongs shig sbyongs shig srungs srungs/ zhes pa'i sngags rnams lan gsum gsum brjod cing lag gnyis ka reg ste byin gyis brlabs/ 'bru gsum brjod cing pad kor byas la/ yig brgya yang brjod pa ni/ rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyang ba'o// ba byung lnga ni/ legs grub las/ dmar ser ba yi 'o ma dang*// ba yi zho dang ba yi mar// ba gcin ba yi lci ba dang*// zhes gsungs pa rnams dri bzang dang sbyar ro// de nas/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pas sa gzhi de bzhin nyid kyi rang bzhin shin tu rnam par dag par gyur/ ces mos pa ni bla na med pa'i dag pas sbyang ba'o// de yang spyi rgyud las/ khang bzang brag steng ba lang lhas// gtsug lag khang sogs chu 'gram mam// sngon 'dus byas pa'i gnas dag tu// ma brkos na yang dag pa yin// zhes pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa rnying pa rnams su sa brtag pa nas bzung brkos te sbyang ba'i bar rnams bya mi dgos pas sngags chu dang sbyin sreg gi thal bas sbyang ba nas 'go brtsam par bya'o// bzhi pa sa gzung ba ni/

skad cig gis stong pa'i ngang las 'og gi mthar thug cing rgya che bar hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*| |sa 'og nas steng gi bar du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i ra ba dang*/ steng du rdo rje mda'i dra ba dang 'og tu rdo rje'i bla bres brgyan pa'i rdo rje'i gur te/ thams cad kyang sra zhing mkhregs la bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar zhing 'od zer 'khrugs par gyur/ ces thun mong gi srung 'khor bsgom/ slob dpon stegs bu'i dbus su 'khod de mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzlas pa'i bar bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgom la/ slob dpon gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis dbus su gnas la/ phyogs bzhi nas rigs bzhi nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i slob ma bzhi'am/ gcig gis phyogs so sor 'gro ba rigs bzhi'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas shar nas/ rang nyid rdo rje gtsug tor dkar po g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas mdzes pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ nas/ shapada'i bar mchod/ shākya seng ge gtsug tor rnam pa brgyad// sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas| |chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// zhes gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ lho nas/ rang nyid rin chen gtsug tor ser po g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon mnyam bzhag rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas mdzes pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ nas/ shapada'i bar mchod/ shākya seng ge gtsug tor rnam pa brgyad/ */sogs/ mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs// mtshan nyid min pa thams cad spangs// kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog |dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// zhes gsum dang*/

nub nas/ rang nyid pad+ma gtsug tor dmar po phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas mdzes pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ nas/ shapada'i bar mchod/ shākya seng ge gtsug tor rnam pa brgyad// sogs/ zhi ba'i chos mchog las byung ba// ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong mdzad// kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// zhes gsum dang*/ byang nas/ rang nyid sna tshogs gtsug tor ljang gu g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon mnyam bzhag rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas mdzes pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ nas/ shapada'i bar mchod/ shākya seng ge gtsug tor rnam pa brgyad// sogs/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med// kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo sgyur| |dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// zhes gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma med na der mos la rang nyid kyis bgyis kyang rung ngo*// de nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo brkyangs pa rtse sprad pa 'og tu phyogs pas spyi bor bzung zhing*/ hūm̐ badz+rot+tiṣ+ṭha bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ ces dmigs/ langs pa'i kha shar du phyogs pas mnyam pa'i rkang stabs byas la thal mo mgo bor sbyar te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pā da ban+da naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes gsum gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la phyag byas la/ sems can ma rig pa'i mun par song zhing bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa rnams kyi bdud bsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ rang nyid skad cig gis khro bo 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba sku mdog sngon po sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdor dril 'dzin pa'i hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud cing*|

lhag ma gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis kyis thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum pa smin ma 'khyog cing khro gnyer dang bcas pa zhal gdangs shing mche ba rnam par gtsigs la ljags 'dril ba/ mtha' yas nag pos bcings pa'i dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes shing*/ mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyangs pa/ mi rus kyi phyag rgya drug dang ldan zhing klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ mgo bo dang bcas pa'i ska rags can gyi stag lpags kyi sham thabs cung zad grol ba/ g.yas brkyang ba'i zhabs gnyis kyis sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa/ rab tu khros pa'i bskal pa tha ma'i me ltar 'od zer gyi phung po 'bar zhing 'gro ba ma lus pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs za ba lta bu/ hūm̐ sgra drag tu sgrog cing phyogs kun tu lta bar bsgoms pa'i mig g.yas ma las nyi ma dang*| g.yon ṭa las zla ba/ mig 'bras hūm̐ las dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar bar gyur/ ces rdo rje'i lta ba 'dis phyogs kun tu 'gro ba la nga rgyal bskyed par dmigs te/ nga ni rang nyid rdo rje can// rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid nga*// nga ni sangs rgyas rgyal po che// nga ni stobs can rdo rje can// nga ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal// phyag na rdo rje brtan pa nga*// nga ni bdag po rdo rje che// byin gyis brlabs pa mi 'dor ro// zhes brjod/ rkang mthil dag tu hūm̐ las rdo rje rgya gram 'bar ba re re gsal bar gyur par dmigs pas 'gying ba dang bcas pad kor byed cing rdo rje gsor dril bu dkrol zhing rdo rje'i rkang stabs kyis bskor nas dbus sam dbang ldan gyi mtshams su phyin la/ gang su dag dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa phyogs su gnas pa'i lha klu la sogs pa sa'i bdag po khyod rnams myur du dengs shig

/sa'i phyogs 'dir rdo rje slob dpon bdag gis sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par bya ba'i phyir dang slob ma'am tshe las 'das pa 'di'i/ bdag cag gi mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rdzogs par bya ba'i don du/ bcom ldan 'das ngan song sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po brtsam par bya'o// de'i phyir rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bka' thos nas myur du dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de'i mgo bo bdag gi khro bo rdo rje 'bar ba gsor zhing rab tu gsor ba'i ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po 'dis rnam pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o// lan gsum dang*/ slar yang*/ lus ngag yid la gnas pa yi// bgegs kyi tshogs kun yang dag nyon// nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// bka' yi 'khor lo sbyor ba po// rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzugs kyis ni// lus gsum las skyes 'gas par byed// gal te kha cig bdag las 'da'// 'di ni 'jig 'gyur gzhan du min// zhes lan gsum brjod pas bka' bsgos la/ suṃ bha ni'i sngags brjod/ yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug cing rol mo dang bcas pas/ yid kyis khro bo dpag tu med pa spros pas bgegs rnams bsal te dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi yang dbang chen gyi gting gi bar hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs par gyur par mos la/ rgyas pa na stangs stabs drug cu rtsa gnyis po bya ba'am/ bsdus pa na rdor dril 'dzin pas hūm̐ brjod la skor ba tsam byas pas kyang chad lhag gi skyon du mi 'gyur ro// de nas gzhi de dris byugs la me tog la sogs pas mchod nas/ lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas reg cing gtso bo'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ yig brgya lan bdun bzlas pas byin rlabs brtan par bya'o// de nas rang gi mdun du seng ldeng lcags rus sogs las byas pa'i phur bu sor bco brgyad dam/ bcu gnyis sam/ brgyad pa/ sboms su rang rang gi sum cha dang ldan pa yungs kar dang tsan dan dmar pos byugs shing*/

tshon lngas dkris pa me tog gi phreng ba dmar pos bcings pa bcu snod 'brus bkang bar bzhag la/ thun mong gi srung 'khor gyi dbus su rang nyid rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad du gsal ba'i snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bkug pa hūm̐ las spros pa'i khro bo chen po bcu la gtad de/ khro bo de rnams kyis sgra ring po brjod pa'i hūm̐ las byung ba'i khron pa zab mo bcu'i nang du dbang po la sogs pa'i gzugs can gyi bgegs rnams bcug la phur bu stod khro bo dang smad rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa can bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba re rer gyur pa/ rdo rje khu tshur g.yon pas bzung zhing*/ g.yas pas phyag mtshan dang po yongs su gyur pa'i rdo rje'i tho ba me tog dmar po'i phreng ba bcings pa bzung ste| oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān hūm̐/ rdo rje phur bus bgegs rnams thams cad phur bus thob/ zhes sam/ yang na/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ phaṭa phaṭa kī li kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ chom chom 'joms par gyis gdug pa can thams cad phur bus phur bus sdig pa thams cad la thob/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti sarba bigh+nān kā ya wāka tsit+ta kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sku gsung thugs rdo rje phur bu rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin du brjod/ bgegs thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum la phur bus thob/ zhes pa sngon du 'gro bas rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab nas/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas brdung bar bsam/ dbang ldan nas bzung ste g.yas skor du dkyil 'khor gyi me ri'i phyi mtshams su rdul gyi gong bu brgyad phyogs mtshams su bkod pa'i sbubs rnams su btab cing*/ gtsug tor shar gyi shar dang*/ gnod mdzes nub kyi nub tu btab pas phur bu bcug go// gnas dog na sgrub khang gi phyi rol tu btab kyang rung*/

de ltar phur bu btab pa dang brdungs pas bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bde ba chen po'i de bzhin nyid du ro gcig par byas te bgegs lhag ma rnams kyang rgyang ring du bros par gyur par bsam/ gal te phur bu bzhi las med na mtshams bzhi'am sgo bzhir gdab la/ de'ang med na ngag tu brjod pa ltar bsgoms te gdab brdung bya zhing lag g.yas gan rkyal bsgyur nas/ oṃ badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing sa la bsnun pas kyang chad lhag gi skyon mi 'gyur bar bshad do// gnyis pa sta gon la gsum/ sa sta gon/ lha sta gon/ bum pa sta gon no// dang po ni/ sa'i lha mo lhag par gnas pa'i don du dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi de'i dbus su 'dug pa'i mdun du dri'i thig le me tog gi tshom bus spras pa'i mdun du mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams la/ lce hūm̐ las skyes pa rdo rje rtse gcig pa hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sa de'i dbus su baṃ las byung ba'i sa'i lha mo zhi ba rab tu dga' ba'i thugs can na bza' dkar po mnabs shing*/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon gser gyi bum pa bsnams pa/ pad zla'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang gi lag pa g.yas par zla ba la hūm̐ gsum gsal ba'i 'od phreng phyogs kun tu 'bar bar gyur/ hūm̐ */ sa 'og gnas pa'i lha mo ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bo mthong ba dang dam tshig pa dang lhan cig 'dres par gyur/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā nas/ shapada'i bar sbyar/ oṃ a kā ro nas na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon sa yi lha// lha mo chen mo 'jig rten gsum// rin chen kun gyi rab dga' ma// bzang po'i rgyan gyis rnam brgyan ma// do shal rkang gdub sgra ldan ma// rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma// mchod yon 'di ni bzhes nas su/ */dkyil 'khor las ni rab grub mdzod// hi hi hi hi haṃ swā hā// skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par 'phags// sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la| |lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// ji ltar bdud kyi dpung bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi dpung*// bcom nas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// zhes lan gsum/

sa'i lha mos de ltar gyis shig gnang ba byin te/ sa'i lha mo sa de nyid la thim par gyur par mos pa las/ steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs pa sogs skabs 'dir mi dgos/ de nas rdo rje bsdams pha'i phyag rgyas sa de mnan la/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa hūm̐/ zhes gsum brjod la/ rdo rje bsdams pa las byung ba'i yi ge hūm̐ 'od 'bar ba 'phros pas dbang chen gyi 'og gi bar rdo rjer byas par gyur par mos shing*/ oṃ badz+ra dṛ ḍho tiṣ+ṭha/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs te sa gzhi de rang gi dbang du bya'o// gnyis pa lha sta gon ni/ stegs bu de nyid yi ge gsum bzlas pa'i dri'i chus byugs shing*/ me tog gis gcal du bkram pa'i dbus nas bzung*/ gtsug tor dgu la dri'i lha gnas gru bzhi pa re re dang*/ rtsa ba'i lha gzhan rnams la dri thig zlum po re re/ khor yug gi mgron thabs la'ang dri thig chung du lha grangs dang mnyam par bya zhing*/ yang na dri'i thig le rnams kyi steng du dris sbags pa'i me tog dkar po'i tshom bu byas kyang rung*/ de dag gang byed kyi mthar chu bzhi nyer spyod gtor ma gnyis dang bcas pa bshams la/ dkyil 'khor bsangs gzi sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung dkar po nam mkha'i tshul can 'og phra zhing steng yangs pa la gnas pa'i zhes pa nas/ bstod pa'i bar mdun bskyed ltar bsgoms te/ pus mo g.yas btsugs/ lce hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ bcom ldan rdo rje rtag pa mchog /rig pa'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud// slob ma rnams la brtse phyir dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// mgon po thugs rje bdag nyid can// dkyil 'khor bri bar bdag 'tshal lo// de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la// bka' drin gnang bar mdzad par rigs// sangs rgyas 'gro don bya don stsol// byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang*// gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha// lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang*// 'byung po byang chub brten gnas dang*// sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba// gang su rdo rje'i spyan mnga' rnams// bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol// bdag ni che ge rdo rje can// shākya seng ge'i dkyil 'khor ni// ji ltar nus pas nyer spyod pas// 'gro ba sbyang phyir bri bar bya| |de phyir bdag dang slob ma la// rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung nas// dkyil 'khor dang bcas thams cad ni// nye bar spyod par mdzad par rigs// zhes don dran bzhin pas lan gsum gsol ba btab/

mchod pa sna tshogs kyis bskor te mchod cing bstod la bzhugs su gsol/ dkyil chog gzhan rnams su 'dir las kyi thig chog dang bcas gdab par bshad kyang rdo rje phreng ba las thig dang ye thig cho ga thun mong du bshad nas ye thig kho nar mdzad pa'i phyir 'dir yang de nyid gtso bor bzhag pa dag go// gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni/ slob dpon khrus byas/ gos gsar pa gyon zhing rgyan dang bcas te/ gzhung las bshad pa lta bu'i bum pa rnams kyi nang du/ gser/ dngul/ mu tig /byi ru| mu men te rin po che lnga/ til/ nas/ gro/ 'bras/ sran ma ste 'bru lnga/ sle tres/ dbang lag /shu dag dkar po/ kaṇ+ḍa ka ri/ rgya mtsho'i lbu ba ste sman lnga/ kat+pū ra/ gur gum/ tsan+dan dkar dmar/ ri dwags lte ba ste dri lnga/ til dkar nag /lan tshwa/ rtsi mar/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsi ste snying po lnga rnams sil bur byas pa dang 'o ma sbags pa'i chus gang ba 'du bya/ gtso bum dang las thams cad pa gnyis bcas/ gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar gyis brab te bgegs bskrad la/ 'o ma dang 'dres pa'i tap+te bzlas pa'i chus sum gnyis bkang la lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas dang ldan pa'i 'bras can gyi shing gis kha brgyan/ dar dmar ram/ ser po'am/ dkar po gang rung gi mgul chings/ rnam rgyal la ze prog gsum gnyis gang rung can nam/ yang na gnyis kar kha tshar ma nyams pa'i ras zung gis mgul dkris pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ bdun bzlas pa'i srad bu dkar pos lan bdun dkris la/ oṃ badz+ra shi ṣa re ru ṭa ma ṭa di shaṃ bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐/ zhes dkris la| rnam rgyal bum pa la gur gum sogs dri'i chus rtsa lha rnams kyi sa bon nam zla ba'i ste bar muṃ dang*/ las thams cad pa la nyi ma'i dbus su k+ṣaṃ bris pa dag rnam rgyal shar sgo'i g.yas dang las thams cad pa shar sgo'i g.yon/ yang na slob dpon gyi nye logs su mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams/ rnam rgyal gtso bo yin pa dang*/ bya ba mang ba'i phyir rnam rgyal gyi steng du lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas kyis sbags pa'i dri chu/

oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tod ka ṭha hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byas pa'i rdo rje'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin dang ldan par gyur/ ces brjod cing dung chos sam pad snod du stsal ba rnam rgyal gyi steng du bkod pa 'di la rgyal ba'i bum pa zhes pa'i tha snyad kyang 'dogs so// de'i steng du me tog gi phreng ba dang kha dog lnga ldan gyi srad bu btags pa'i rdo rje hūm̐ gis sngags pa bzhag la/ chog gzhung ltar bum bskyed 'don/ dkyil 'khor bris ma zin bar du bum pa rnams lha sta gon gyi tshom bu'i gan nam logs su mchod pa dang bcas pas skabs su mchod bstod sngags bzla ba sogs kyang bya dgos so// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ dkyil 'khor bri zhing rgyan dgram pa/ sgrub cing mchod pa/ dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing slob ma la dbang bskur ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ thig gdab pa dang*/ tshon bskyed pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ las thig gi cha dbye ba dang*/ ye thig gi byin gyis brlabs pa'o// dang po ni/ rang gis dbang bskur zin pa'i slob ma'am lha gnas byas pa'i sgo'i slob dpon du 'os pa dag gam/ med na rang nyid kyis lha sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor la mchod cing bstod la/ de nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo brkyangs pa rtse sprad pa 'og tu phyogs pas spyi bor bzung zhing*/ hūm̐ badz+ro t+tiṣ+ṭha/ lha sta gon gyi lha rnams ye shes gi thig gi don du nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ ces mos la gzhi de'i mchod pa rnams bsdus la/ bum pa rnams dben par mchod pa dang bcas pas bzhugs su gsol/ gnyis pa ye thig gis byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang nyid gtso bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa gzhon nu ma nyams pas byin zhing bkal ba'am/ dpa' bos rin gyis nyos pa'i srad bu srid du slob dpon dang slob ma'i mdzub mo nas sor mo bzhi'i dbus su bcug cing drangs nas rdo rje khu tshur du byas pas mdzub mo'i rgyab sa la sbyar ba ma gtogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur dang*/

sboms su sgo'i nyi shu cha dang ldan pa dri zhim po'i chu dang yungs kar gyis sbags pa tshon sna lngas kha bsgyur ba dkar po lnga/ ser po lnga sogs/ lnga tshan lnga snod gtsang mar bzhag la/ lag g.yon pa'i mthil du mthe bong gi rtsa ba sogs su bkod cing*/ oṃ swā āḥhā hūm̐ las byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i ngo bor gyur par dmigs la/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i thugs kar yi ge lnga las grub pa'i ye shes kyi srad bu 'od zer gyi rang bzhin du gyur ces dmigs la/ oṃ aḥsha shwa ta badz+ra sū tra m+me pra yats+tsha ma hā maṇ+ḍal sū tra ṇa ya hūm̐/ zhes rnam snang dang*/ de bzhin du/ sha shwa ta'i gnas su rat+na saṃ bha wa/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ a mi tā bha/ 'od dpag med/ a mo gha sid+dhi/ don yod grub pa/ ak+ṣo bh+yaḥ mi bskyod pa/ rnams bcug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa lnga la gsol ba btab cing*/ mig g.yas dang g.yon gnyis dza las skyes pa'i zla ba dang nyi ma ser po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ ces mos la/ oṃ dīp+ta dṛṣ+ṭi/ aṅku sha dzaḥ zhes brjod nas/ mig gnyis myur du bsgril nas rdzi ma 'degs shing*/ rdeb pas 'bar ba'i lta stangs lcags kyu lta bus rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa bskul te de rnams kyis spros pa'i thig skud lnga so sor byon nas rang gi lag pa'i thig skud so sor thim par gyur par mos la/ de nas rdo rje gnod sbyin du bskyed pa'i slob mas thig skud kyi sne rnams 'dzin pa dang lhan cig slob dpon gyis/ oṃ āḥ.a n+yo n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmāḥpa raspa ra a nu pra wiṣ+ṭa sarba dharmāḥ.ad+yan+ta a nu pra wiṣ+ṭa sarba dharmāḥ.oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos thams cad phan tshun rjes su 'gro ba/ chos thams cad shin tu rjes su 'jug pa/ zhes brjod cing*/ dang po dkar po lnga srad bu gcig tu bya zhing de bzhin du ser po sogs mdog mthun lnga re srad bu re re bya zhing*/

slar thams cad gcig tu dril ba'i thig skud byas pa sa stegs kyi khar gser la sogs pa'i snod du dri'i chu dang ba'i rnam lngas byugs la bzhag ste/ thig skud kyi sne gnyis su/ oṃ hūm̐ dang dbus su āḥste yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par gyur ces dmigs la/ oṃ pañtsa dzñā na sū tra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ puṣ+paṃ dang dhū pe sbyar ba gsum gsum gyis mchod/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag g.yas kyis reg cing las sngags bzlas pas bsrungs la bzhag go| |de nas/ mig g.yas par ma las nyi ma dang g.yon par ṭa las zla ba 'od 'phro ba gsal bar gyur par dmigs la/ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi ma ṭa/ zhes brtan par byas nas las sngags bzlas pa'i bum chu dang yungs kar dang dri'i chus thig skud la gtor zhing lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas reg la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ rdo rje'i dam tshig thig le rim pas/ zhes dang*/ 'bru gsum rtsa brgyad bzlas pas lha gnas bya'o// de nas las bum mam bum pa thams cad kyi chus dkyil 'khor gyi gzhir bsang gtor byas la/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ thams cad dag par sbyongs/ zhes brjod pas gtsang bar byas la/ dri bzang byugs shing phyi rol du me tog gcal du bkram la/ nam mkha'i khams su bri bya'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa skad cig gis bzhugs par gyur/ ces dmigs/ chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mos mchod cing bstod la/ rang nyid rdor dril 'dzin pas gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis slob ma las thams cad par bskyed de/ rang dang slob ma'i g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i mig dag la dzaḥyig las skyes pa'i zla ba dang nyi ma 'od zer ser po 'phro bzhin par gyur par dmigs/ mnyam pa'i rkang stabs kyis slob dpon nub nas shar du blta zhing slob ma de las bzlog pas slob dpon gyi rdo rje khu tshur g.yon pas thig skud lte ba'i thad du bzung ba'i sne mo g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis slob ma la gtad de/

dz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥ zhes chen po gsum dang slar/ dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes rkyang ba gsum gyis bskul zhing*/ slob mas kyang*/ dzaḥlci yang drug brjod pas blangs la g.yas skor du slob mas phyi 'gros kyis slob dpon la rgyab mi bstan par 'gro nas dpon slob gnyis kas thig skud lte ba'i thad du bzung bar snang la brkyangs te/ slob dpon gyis/ phyogs thams cad du mnyam pa nyid do// zhes brjod cing der mos la/ slob dpon gyis g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis thig skud bzung bas steng nas 'og tu bsdogs pas tshangs thig gnyis 'debs pa'i tshul bya zhing se gol gyi sgra bya'o// slar slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ swa āḥhā/ zhes brjod cing slar thig gi sgra las/ sems can don du khyed rnams kyi// dus yin de phyir 'dir byon zhig /ces bskul ba'i tshe nam mkha' khyab pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bskul bas de rnams byon te thig skud la thim par gyur ces dmigs la| thig skud lte ba las smad de tshangs thig gnyis ji lta bar gdab cing*/ slar ye thig de las thig thams cad kyi steng du gdab pas byin gyis brlabs par bya'o// de ltar thig rnams zin nas dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par grub par mos la/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badz+ra be ga kra ma hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje'i shugs kyi sngags rgyas/ ye shes kyi thig nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ ces mos la/ rdor dril 'dzin pas pad kor byas la gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis/ mig g.yas g.yon hūm̐ las zla ba dang nyi mar gyur/ ces dmigs te khro bo'i lta bas phyogs kun tu blta zhing*/ hīḥhīḥ thar pa'i sgo'i gegs su gyur pa'i sgrib pa rnams dbye bar bya'o// zhes brjod cing der mos pas tshangs pa'i g.yas g.yon sgo nang gi 'phred kyi rtsa thig che chung gnyis gnyis dag dbye'o// de nas ye shes kyi thig skud sngar ltar snod du bzhag pa la/

slob dpon bden bral nas dbang ldan du phyogs pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes thig skud la chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mos mchod cing*/ a kā ro gsum gyis gtor ma phul la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra muḥ tshon sna lnga'i srad bu'i ye shes pa rnams nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i thugs kar thim par gyur/ ces mos la tshon sna lnga'i thig skud gnas dben par bzhag go// gnyis pa tshon bskyed pa la gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor gyi tshon sa bstan pa dang*/ lha'i mtshan ma dgod pa'o// dang po ni/ skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor sa la gtor ma nang gtor ltar phul rjes/ tshon kha dog lnga po snod lngar bzhag par dri dang spos dang me tog gsum bshams la/ tshon dkar po la buṃ/ ser po la āḥ dmar po la hrīḥ ljang khu la khaṃ/ sngon po la hūm̐ rnams bris te/ tshon rnams baṃ laṃ raṃ haṃ yaṃ las skyes pa'i tshon dkar ser dmar ljang nag po'i kha dog can/ bh+rūṃ aṃ hrīḥhaṃ hūm̐ rnams las skyes pa'i rnam snang*/ rin 'byung*/ 'od dpag med/ don grub/ mi bskyod pa rnams su gsal bar gyur/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i rgyal ba lnga'i thugs kar bum sogs sa bon so so las grub pa'i ye shes kyi tshon kha dog lnga gnas pa bdag gi 'bar ba'i lta stangs kyis bkug ste tshon so so la bcug pas ro gcig tu gyur/ ces dmigs la/ tshon so so rang rang gi sa bon brgya la sogs bzlas pas sngags shing*/ thun mong du/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes brgya sogs sngags la/ slar tshon rnams la sngar bris pa'i sa bon rnams mi 'jig par byas te/ sa bon re re'i gzhogs su hrīḥre re bris te 'bar ba'i lta bas gzi byin bskyed cing*/ ngag tu/ bden pa gang gis sems can rnams rdul mang zhing sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can la chags pas rjes su chags par 'gyur ba'i bden pa des rdul tshon rnams 'bar bar gyur cig

/ces gsum brjod la bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis sbar bas/ lha sgom pa phul du byung ba'i nus ldan gyis ni tshon rnams rab 'bar zhing*/ 'bring du ba/ tha mas kyang mdangs dang gzi byin skye'o// slar/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya gan+dhe pra tīts+tshaswā hā/ zhes dri dang me tog spos gsum la sngags sbyar bas mchod nas snod so sor bzhag par bya'o// spros pa la mi dga' ba dag thig tshon byin rlabs phyogs gcig tu byed na tshon lnga'i steng du mdog mthun gyi srad bu bzhag la gong ltar byas pas 'grub bo// zlum thig bskor ba'i lte bar phur pa dngos su btab yod na phur bu de nyid/ oṃ badz+ra kī la ya udakī la ya sarba kī lān badz+ra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa hoḥ zhes skam pa'i rgyas phyung la rang gi lag gi rdo rje la bstim/ phur khung nam mkha' rlung me chu sa'i rim pas/ tshon 'og nas rim gyis ljang nag dmar dkar ser ba lngas bkang la mnyam par bya'o// de nas ye thig sngar nas nam mkhar bteg pa'i de dag gi 'og nas zhugs te slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su song la kha shar du lta bas/ lag g.yas rdo rje khu tshur dang g.yon dril bu dang bcas pa'i mtheb srin gyis tshon bzung la/ chos dbyings 'di ni dag pa ste// sems can khams ni rab sgrol mdzad// rang nyid rgyal po rdo rje 'chang*// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// nyes pa kun las rnam par grol// 'khor lo nang du yang dag gnas// zhes chos dbyings rnam par dag par mos la/ oṃ badz+ra re kha sa ma ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing dbang ldan nas brtsams te rtsig pa g.yas skor du phyi nas dkar sngo dmar ljang ser ba'i re kha lnga po mtho re tsam bris pa'i steng du rin po che'i snod bkab pa'i steng du rdo rje bzhag la mchod pa gsum gyis mchod/ dar cig lon nas rtsig pa gzhan dang sprel ran pa'i tshe kha phye la pra legs nyes brtag

/legs na/ e ma hoḥ zhes spro ba bskyed/ ngan na stong pa nyid bsgom/ de nas tshon bkyes grub nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs nam mkha'i ye thig dkyil 'khor gyi thig so so la thim par gyur ces mos la/ de nas gtsug tor dgu'i dkyil 'khor bris pa rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur par mos la/ hūm̐ dang las sngags bzlas pa'i dri'i chus bsangs shing dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol tu byugs/ tshon lhag ma rnams kyi ye shes pa la ye thig ltar mchod cing bstod/ bstod par 'os pa sogs dang*/ a kā ros gtor ma phul la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra muḥ zhes ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ tshon lhag ma rnams dben par bzhag go// thig tshon gyi chad lhag gi nyes pa zhi ba'i phyir yig brgya brjod cing dkyil 'khor bskor ba'ang spro na bya la/ mi spro na phreng ba'i gzhung du ma bshad pas ma byas kyang 'thad do// gnyis pa rgyan dgram pa ni/ sngar lha gnas byas pa'i bum pa rnams dkyil 'khor la g.yas skor du dgod do/ de yang bum pa lha grangs dang mnyam pa yod na dbang gi tshe bum pa so sos dbang bskur/ mi dgos pa zor yang pa'i ched du bum pa kun gyi chu bsdus pa rnam rgyal du blugs shing*/ chu des bkang ba'i dung chos mna' chu'i ched du rnam rgyal gyi steng du bzhag pa slob dpon gyis g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas thogs shing g.yon dril bu dkrol/ bum pa gzhan rnams slob ma rnams kyis bzung la/ so so'i sngags bzla zhing gdugs dang bcas spos dang rol chen gyis sna drangs la dkyil 'khor la g.yas skor gsum byas te/ me ri'i phyi rol du gtso bo'i bum pa shar sgo'i thad ka las cung zad g.yas su bzhag /lha gzhan rnams ni rang rang gi phyogs so sor gnas ma 'chol bar bzhag cing*/ las thams cad pa shar sgo'i g.yon nam dbang ldan du bzhag go// bum pa gnyis las med na rnam rgyal shar sgo'i g.yas dang*/ las thams cad pa gong ltar 'god/

'dir g.yas g.yon ni kha nang lta'i dbang du byas pa dag go// bum pa rgyas pa na rtsa lha so sor bum pa re re/ 'bring na gtsug tor dgu la re re/ tha na rnam rgyal dang las bum gnyis bya/ bum mtshan yang bum pa rgyas pa'i tshe lha so so gdan phyag mtshan dang bcas pa so sor bris/ 'bring la gtsug dgu rang rang gi gdan phyag mtshan bum pa dgu la bkod/ bsdus pa'i bum mtshan ni cho ga gzhung du bshad pa ltar bya/ rgyas bsdus gang la'ang mgron thabs la bum pa mi dgos pas so// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi mthar phyogs so sor chu bzhi'i snod dung chos bzed zhal dang bcas pa 'di nyid sbyin sreg 'od kyi snye ma'i skabs su bshad pa'i rdzas so sos sbags pa dang*/ gzhan yang nyer spyod rol mo'i bye brag /'dod yon lnga/ sgeg sogs brgyad/ rgyal srid bdun la sogs pa mchod pa'i tshogs mtha' yas pa rab 'bur/ 'bring bris pa/ tha ma yid kyis sprul pa dang*| yol ba/ bla bre/ gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ 'phan/ lda ldi la sogs pa du ma dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs so sor ga bur dang*/ a ga ru sogs sbyar ba'i spos phor dang*/ na bza'/ gos zung*/ rin po che sman 'brus gang ba'i gser dngul sogs kyi bum pa/ 'das pa'i gtor ma rgyas par na lha grangs dang mnyam par nyer spyod la sogs pa mchod pa'i tshogs rnams g.yas su bskor te bkod legs par bshams pa dbang bskur sngar ma thob pa'i mis dkyil 'khor mi mthong ba'i slad du yol ba bris la bzhag go// nye logs su 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma sogs mkho ba'i chas rnams dang*/ slob dpon gyi nye logs su rdor dril/ dbu rgyan/ gdong g.yogs/ me tog /stod g.yogs la sogs pa mdor na dbang dang dngos gzhi la 'jug pa'i skabs su mkho ba dgos so 'tshal thams cad ma tshang ba med pa bshams/ skabs su bab pa'i las rab gnas dang sbyin sreg sogs la'ang so so'i yo byad rang gzhung ltar bya ba'am/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir mda' rgod sgro can/

oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing sgreng thabs su bkod/ sngar gyi bsrung ba'i phur bu bcu la sgul skyod ma song bar bya de ltar legs par bshams zin nas/ de rnams la hūm̐ dang gtso bo'i sngags bzlas la/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes pas 'bul lo// gnyis pa dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang*/ mchod pa bya ba'o// dang po ni/ slob dpon khrus bya/ stod g.yogs/ smad g.yogs/ gtsug tor sogs chas dang ldan pas shar sgor dkyil 'khor la phyogs pas nub tu kha blta la 'god do// bris pa'i dkyil 'khor de nyid bsangs gzi sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gyi dbus su chos 'byung dkar po nam mkha'i dbyibs can zhes pa nas/ ji srid 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol| dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa'i bar gzhung ltar byas la/ de ltar spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams rang nyid 'khor lo'i dbang phyug tu gsal ba'i kha nang du bcug nas lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen pos 'od du zhu ba thugs kar gnas pa/ slar yang ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i bdag nyid du spros te dam tshig gi 'khor lo la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes mos/ slar yang sa bzung ba'i tshe nam mkhar bteg pa'i dkyil 'khor gcig dang lha sta gon gyi tshe nam mkhar bteg pa'i dkyil 'khor te/ dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi bdag nyid can rnams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mos mchod nas/ shākya seng ge gtsug tor rnam pa brgyad// sogs/ zhes sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis dang spyan drangs pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i bdag nyid kyi dkyil 'khor pa rnams dang bsgoms pa'i dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor pa ste dkyil 'khor bzhi po chu la chu bzhag pa ltar dbyer med du gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur ces dang*/

de nas/ mgron thabs rnams kyang rang rang gi gnas nas 'ongs te zhes pa nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po'i dbu brgyan par gyur gyi bar gzhung ltar bya'o// gnyis pa mchod pa bya ba ni/ gzhung ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te cho ga gzhung gi mdun bskyed kyi skabs ltar mchod pa rgyas par 'bul zhing*/ bstod pas kyang bstod la/ bzlas pa bya ba sogs gzhung ltar bya'o| |rtsa ba'i lha la gzhung ltar gtor ma phul nas sgrub grogs dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug la// dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol du mgron thabs rnams la gtor ma dbul zhing nye reg sogs gzhung ltar bya zhing*/ nang du 'ongs te chad lhag kha bskang ba'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dang lha rnams tshim pa'i slad du rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg kyang bya'o// de nas slob dpon hūm̐ mdzad kyi nga rgyal gyis me tog gi phreng ba blangs te/ suṃ bha ni'i sngags brjod cing rdo rje shugs kyi sngags rgyas/ rtsig pa bteg pa'i 'og nas zhugs te dkyil 'khor gyi nang du rdo rje gsor dril bu gsil zhing rdo rje'i rkang stabs kyis/ oṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ āḥphaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ āḥ.āḥ.āḥphaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ ha na mā ra ya duṣ+ṭāṃ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya a āḥhūm̐ hrīḥphaṭa/ ces pa'i bzlas sngags rnams bzla zhing sgo'i slob dpon rnams dang lhan cig bskor ba byas la sgo'i slob dpon yod na sgo'i slob dpon rnams kyis bshad ma thag pa'i sngags bzla zhing slob dpon gyis suṃ bha ni'i sngags bzla/ sgo'i slob dpon med na rang nyid kyis sngags bzla zhing bskor/ de nas lhag pa dang chad pa'i nyes pa zhi ba'i phyir 'khor lo la bltas te me tog gi phreng ba gtso bo la phul bar bsam mo// slar bskor ba re dang lhan cig thog mar nub tu song la g.yon brkyang gi rdo rje khu tshur gyis mthe'u chung gnyis lcags sgrog ltar sbrel/ mdzub mo rtse sprad pa'i rgyas/

oṃ badz+roṅghā ṭa sa ma ya pra we sha ya hūm̐/ zhes shar gyi sgo dbye/ de bzhin du byang nas lho/ shar nas nub/ lho nas byang gi sgo rnams la/ slar/ oṃ sa ma ya pra we sha yā mi/ zhes sngar phul ba'i me tog de nyid gar byed cing blangs la rang gi mgor bcings/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug la phyag byas te/ sems can thams cad dngos grub thams cad kyi bka' drin stsol cig /ces gsol ba btab bo// shar sgo nub nas 'byed pa sogs ni nang nas 'byed pa'i dbang du byas pa'o// gsum pa dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang bskur ba la gnyis te/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba'o// dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang par 'jug pa'i tshe slob dpon rang nyid kyis/ oṃ pra we sha sogs sngags dang pos spro ba bskyed cing zhugs nas g.yas skor du 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi gzungs kyis sgo phye ste/ oṃ pa ra ma sogs kyis me tog dor la me tog de nyid phreng ba'i dbang gi don du rang gi mgor bcings/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gis rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba mdzad par bsam la/ smad g.yogs sbyin pa nas gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal gyi bar chog gzhung gi slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi skabs ltar las slob ma zhes pa'i mal du bdag nyid ces 'don pa spos la slob ma'i bya ba rnams rang gis byas pas dbang rdzogs par blangs/ de nas slob ma gzhug pa'i ched du bde ba che na po'i bdag nyid thabs kyi rang bzhin de kho na nyid kyi bstod pa sngon du 'gro bas dkyil 'khor gyi dngos grub zhu zhing bden pa'i byin rlabs bya ba'i phyir rdor dril 'dzin pas/ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan med phyir/ nas/ kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog gi bar chog gzhung ltar lan gsum bya'o// 'di'i don rgyas bshad dkyil chog 'jigs med dgongs rgyan du gsal lo// gnyis pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ni gdong g.yogs dang bcas te gzhug pa nas/

cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol gyi bar chog gzhung ltar slob ma la dbang bskur zhing spros pa la dga' na dbang don rgyas par bshad de gzhan yid tshim par bya zhing*/ spros pa la mi dga' na'ang gzhung du bris pa'i tshig cha dang lag len gab 'khrugs/ 'ol tshod/ ras gcod/ gzu lum/ spyi brtol spangs la bya dgos so// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ chad lhag gi kha skong ba zhi ba dang*/ lha rnams tshim pa'i slad du rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg byas la/ rang gis kyang ci nus pas dkyil 'khor mchod cing slob ma rnams kyang ci nus dkyil 'khor mchod du gzhug /dkyil 'khor la phul ba'i bza' btung lhag ma rnams der 'dus kun la sbyin zhing tshim par byas/ de dag dang lhan cig mtshan thog thag ma nyal bar glu gar dang byang chub sems kyi rtogs pa yang dag par mchod nas/ slob dpon gyis slob ma rnams la/ khyod rnams kyis 'jug pa 'di lta bu su la'ang smra bar mi bya'o zhes bsgo/ de nas phreng bar/ slob ma las kyang yon blang bya// des kyang gus pas dbul bya ste// rin chen yid 'ong chung ma dang*// rang gi lus dang sa gzhi dang*// mdor na bya ba de 'dra bas| |ji ltar bla ma mnyes 'gyur bya// bla ma mnyes na dngos grub 'byung*// gzhan du min zhes thub pas gsungs// slob dpon bla ma byed pa po// rdo rje sems dpa' mchod pa las// de yi bsod nams mang byed cing*// dka' thub ma spyad pa yang gang*| |zhes pa ltar/ slob dpon gyis yon blangs shing slob mas kyang dpya khral ltar 'khreb spangs la mos pas dbul/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te 'bul zhing bstod pa nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ muḥ zhes pa'i bar chog gzhung lta bur gshegs su gsol/ chos thams cad skye ba med par mos la/ g.yon dril bu gsil zhing g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i srin lag gis dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas brtsams te tshangs thig gi lam nas me ri nas bzung gtso bo'i gnas kyi bar phyis la tshon phran bu rang gi mgor byugs nas lha gnas rnams dbye zhing*/

slar sgo gzhan rnams dang zur rnams kyang rdo rje'i rtse mos gzhig go/ 'on kyang thog mar lha mtshan rnams bsdus rjes rdo rjes 'jig pa lag len legs so// de nas slob dpon rkang pa g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas cung zad bskums la/ rdor dril 'dzin pa rdo rje bsdams pa'i mdzub mo gnyis skam pa'i rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra kī la udakī la ya sarba kī lān badz+ra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa hoḥ zhes phur bu rnams bton la/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swā hā/ zhes pa 'o ma la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i phur bu'i dbal bkrus pas bgegs rnams kyi rmas pa sos par bsam/ phur bu'i lha la nyer spyod lngas mchod| yig brgyas chad lhag kha bskangs la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol zhing*/ gong gi 'o mas phur khung rnams bkang ngo*// nad zhi ba sogs kyi phyir tshon phran bu slob ma la byin la/ gzhan rnams rnam rgyal bum pa'am bum pa gzhan gos kyis brgyan par blugs te rgyan du mas spras te/ rta glang sogs sam do li'i khri la bzhag cing yon bdag gis byin pa'i gos kyis brgyan pa'i gzhon nus bum pa bzung*/ slob dpon gyis dril bu 'khrol zhing*/ gzhan rnams kyis gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan dang*/ rol mo sna tshogs pa dang bkra shis pa'i glu gar dang spos phor gyis sna drangs shing*/ 'bab chu chen po'am/ mtsho chen po'am/ chu mig chen por khyer te de'i 'gram du 'dug la/ stegs bu gru bzhi ba byung dang dri bzang gis byugs pa'i steng sa dkar pos pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su shākya seng ge'i muṃ dang*/ 'dab ma brgyad la mdun nas brtsams te phyogs bzhi dang*/ dbang ldan nas brtsams te mtshams bzhir g.yas skor du phuḥbargyad bris pa'i mthar nyer spyod lnga dang 'o ma'i gtor ma bshams la bsangs gzi sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su seng ge'i khri la shākya seṅge rnam snang chen po 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha lugs can 'dab ma shar nas phyogs bzhi dang dbang ldan nas mtshams bzhir g.yas skor du mtha' yas dang*/

pad+ma dang*/ 'jog po dang*/ nor rgyas dang*/ pad+ma chen po dang*/ dung skyong dang*/ karko ṭa dang*/ rigs ldan rnams rang rang gi mdog can du gsal bar rang rang gi snying kha'i sa bon gyis bkug ste so so la thim par gyur par mos la/ oṃ āḥ.a nan+tā ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥpad+mā ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥtak+ṣa kā ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥbā su kī ye hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥm hā pad+mā ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥshaṅkha pā lā ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥkarko ṭā ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥku li kā ya hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes dang*/ nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ 'o ma'i gtor ma 'bru gsum dang*/ a kā ro gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ a nan+ta/ bā su kī/ tak+ṣa ka/ karko ṭa/ pad+ma/ ma hā pad+ma/ shaṅkha pā la/ ku li ka pā la/ de ba ti/ ma hā de ba ti/ sau ma shi khi/ ma hā sau ma shi khi/ daṇ+ḍa dha ra/ ma hā daṇ+ḍa dha ra/ a pā la/ hu lun/ nan+da/ u pa nan+da/ sā ga ra| ma hā sā ga ra/ tap+ta/ ma hā tap+ta/ shrī kan+ta/ ma hā shri kan+ta/ rat+na kan+ta/ su rū pa/ ma hā su rū pa/ bha dra hi ka /ma ho ra ga /shī li/ ma hā shī li/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha/ ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ti sarba bhurbahu wa phruṃ phruṃ swā hā/ zhes gsum gyis gtor ma phul la/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni// sa 'og mun pa ma lus bsal mdzad pa// bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ */klu rgyal btsun mo 'khor g.yog bcas la bstod// ces bstod la/ rdul tshon klu rnams la byin pas klu rnams kyang bkur sti chen po dang bcas sa 'og gi 'jig rten du khyer bar gyur par mos la rdul tshon chur blugs/ 'dab ma dbus kyi shākya seng ge rang gi snying khar thim par mos/ slar yang*/ gang du rdul tshon khyer ba'i bum pa de chus bkang la snga ma bzhin khyer te zhi ba'i don du dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa la sogs pa la gtor bar bya'o|

|ba lci byugs pa'i khang par gzhon nu dang gzhon nu ma rnams la 'o thug gi ston mo bya'o/ /de nas phreng bar/ de nas slob dpon gyis ni nor// mkho ba'i yo byad kun bsdus nas// rang nyid kyis ni spyad par bya// slob ma sogs kyis cung zad min// rmang 'jug pa dang rab gnas dang*// sbyin sreg 'khor lo'i nor gang yin// de kun slob dpon kho na'i zhes// rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog nyid gsungs// zhes pa ltar bya zhing las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas la/ slob dpon dang*/ sgo'i slob dpon rnams dang*/ las kyi rdo rje can dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rnams ji ltar 'os shing nus pas go la dang so rtsi la sogs pas mnyes par bya'o// dge 'dun gyi ston mo dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya'o// dman pa dang mgon med pa rnams kyang longs spyod gzhan dag gis tshim par bya'i/ dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad ni cung zad tsam sus kyang ma yin no// smras pa/ rgol bas 'jigs med nges gsang 'byung gnas mchog /rdo rje rnal 'byor sbas pa'i lam srol rnams// ston mkhas khyod dang ngag dbang lha mo de'i// bka' drin dran pas slar yang phyag bgyi'o// rdo rje'i tshig ldan gsang chen grub pa'i mthar// mkhas par grags pa'i rnam dpyod ldan rnams kyi// ji bzhin rtogs par dka' zhes 'gro gleng na// deng sang rtsad cing dris na tshig bzhi tsam// 'khrul med lung rigs smra ba'i mthu med par// blun po'i 'khor tshogs dbus su longs spyod dang*// khengs dregs 'jig rten chos kyis rgyags pa 'gas// ras gcod spyi brtol byed pa 'di mthong na// 'jigs med lugs bzang rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dpyid// dbyangs can snyems sde'i legs bshad dgongs pa'i rgyan// mkhas grub yongs kyi bka' lung gis phyug pa'i// bstan bcos rtogs nas de la rgyud sde rnams// so sor dbye dang mi dbye phyogs gnyis las// dbye ba'i phyag len yo ga gtsug dgu'i gzhung*// 'khrul med mdor bsdus lhan thabs legs bshad bcas// dpag bsam snye ma 'di ko kho bos sbyar// bslab pa'i legs bshad lung rigs smra ba dang*// 'jig rten grags pa'i rjes 'brangs blun po yi// gzu lum 'chal chos 'di ko ci phyir mnyam// lhan thabs 'di na rgyud gzhung man ngag gnad// 'jigs med lugs bzang phreng ba'i dkyil chog dang*// de don gsal byed 'jigs med dgongs rgyan sogs// legs bshad tshogs dang 'gal ba'i cha shas kyi// nongs pa'i nyes tshogs dri ma yod mi snyam// rgya la bdag blo rgya mtsho'i ska rags ngogs// legs bshad lung rigs du ma'i sa bon tshogs// rnam dpyod gsher gyis bskyed pa'i myu gu la// ma rtogs ba mo'i nyes rgyas bsgribs gyur gang*// mkhyen ldan 'phags ma dbyangs can lha mo yis// lho phyogs chu gter lus med bde mo nas// thugs rje'i rta ljang dbang po nyer spros pa'i// 'od stong tsha zer dra ba'i 'dzum 'od kyis// de kun myur du gzhig la kun mkhyen gyi// 'bras bu skad cig bod pa'i dpal yon stsol// 'di brtsams pa las byung ba'i dge tshogs dag

/kha ba'i mdog ltar dkar ba 'dis mtshon nas// dus gsum bsags yod 'khor 'das rnam dkar tshogs// ma gyur 'gro rnams shākya seṅge yi// go 'phang thob phyir bsngo yi gzhan du min// de ltar bcom ldan 'das ngan song yongs su sbyong ba gtsug tor dgu'i cho ga'i lhan thabs dpag bsam snye ma zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ 'phags yul zla bas 'phel ba'i mching dbang chen po nyid du paṇa grub tshad ldan gdengs can gyi tshogs yongs kyis nye bar bsten pa las/ 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba paṇa chen 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa zhes klu dbang gcig pu nyid du gyur pa de dag gi phyag bzhes phreng ba skor gsum zhes yid bzhin gyi nor bu dpag bsam dbang po lta bur gyur pa dag /nor bu len pa'i ded dpon rnam dpyod du mas phyug pa ji lta ba lo chen chos kyi rje dpal gyis bod du bsgyur ba nyid/ slar karma phrin las gnyis pa 'jigs bral gsung rab gter mdzod sbas pa'i sdes nor bu'i bya ba rnam pa gsum la 'khu ba nyid legs bshad du mas nye bar spras pa de nyid/ rtsod dus kyi rdo rje 'chang zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa drug pa dpal gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug ces sa gsum na snyan pa'i ba dan g.yo ba gor ma chags pa gang des dbang lung dang*/ sbyin sreg gi phyag bzhes/ lung dang rig pa'i legs bshad stong phrag du ma'i gzha' ris kyi bkra ba'i lcibs dang bcas pa bdag cag gi blo gros kyi rgyal mtshan bsgrengs pa'i rtser bkod pa'i mthus/ gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad mtha' dag la ma rmongs pa/ shākya'i dge slong rig pa'i gnas bcu smra ba 'bri gung skyu ra'i gdung gi tha shal du son pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes mig dmar zhes pa/ shing bya gro bzhin gyis nya pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal po gdul bya gzhan dag 'dul ba'i don du yang dag par gshegs pa dge mtshan rmad du byung ba'i dus kyi dmar cha'i bzang po gsum pa'i tshes la/

chu klung nā gardzu na'i sgra 'byin pa'i ngogs/ gzhu smad spro lung gi kun dga' ra ba'i gzim chung dbang ldan pho brang du mgyogs par sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs so// //'di bgyis dge bas khams gsum sems can kun// shākya seng ge'i go 'phang thob gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ//
